worked_solution:
First, we calculate $P(A\cap B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\ \frac{7}{10} & =\frac{1}{2}+\frac{2}{5}-P(A\cap B) \\ P(A\cap B) & =\frac{1}{2}+\frac{2}{5}-\frac{7}{10} \\ P(A\cap B) & =\frac{1}{5}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we construct the corresponding Venn diagram and shade the region $A\cup {B}^{′}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14064054/assets/5ecc7dae3e6b6e57ccd4a7b8907cb4dd20b0ece400a5768b747f3cb3da788e4b.png)

Finally, we have

$$
P(A\cup {B}^{′})=\frac{3}{10}+\frac{1}{5}+\frac{3}{10}=\frac{4}{5}.
$$
